scope: Bounded rapid practice review to guide one inspectable software improvement; not a complete systematic review.
inclusion_criteria: Recent 2022–2026 publications about the relevant review method or workflow
Primary methodological evaluations preferred; official technical/reporting guidance retained regardless of date
Direct relevance to traceability, review records, or practical handoff
exclusion_criteria: Clinical reviews merely mentioning the method without evaluating it
Case-specific correspondence without a transferable method
Sources not selected within the predeclared small appraisal set are logged, not claimed irrelevant

searches.query: ("systematic review"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("search reporting"[Title/Abstract] OR "search documentation"[Title/Abstract] OR "search reproducibility"[Title/Abstract])
searches.query_translation: "systematic review"[Title/Abstract] AND ("search reporting"[Title/Abstract] OR "search documentation"[Title/Abstract] OR "search reproducibility"[Title/Abstract]) AND 2022/01/01:2026/10/20[Date - Publication]
searches.limits: Only offset 0, first 10 by relevance screened; nested authors/MeSH not continued. Nonselected truncated abstracts not fully appraised.
